title: gpuGEM: GPU-based solving of linear optimisation problems over genome-scale metabolic models
description:
gpuGEM solves the linear programmes arising in constraint-based modelling of genome-scale metabolic networks on NVIDIA GPUs, wrapping the cuOpt PDLP first-order solver behind a COBRA-compatible interface.

The repository includes application/, a self-contained causal-gene prioritisation workflow: given a patient's blood biomarker pattern it ranks inherited-metabolic-disease genes by the flux reduction each one induces in the Harvey whole-body metabolic model (81,094 reactions, 56,452 metabolites). The model data, the pipeline and the reference results are all deposited, so the published application results can be reproduced from this archive alone.

This deposit accompanies the gpuGEM manuscript. See README.md for installation and application/README.md for the application.
